scenario: Asked to take notes when take-notes is not installed, then given the notes to file
prompt: I'm about to start a 1-1 with Priya. Take notes.
followups: Here are my notes, file them. We talked about the adapter spike (she owns the write-up, due 2026-11-27), her conference talk, and on-call load. Action: Sam to review the talk outline.
expect: checks whether take-notes is available and says live capture is not available in this session; writes no notes file and invents no meeting content before the user supplies notes; after the notes arrive files them as knowledge/personnel/priya/{{today}}-1-1-priya.md; the filed note has the action items in an `## Action Items` section as `- [ ]` lines; asks whether to add the action items to the session log's open threads; runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools post-route` on the filed note with a summary that lists topics only; knowledge/personnel/priya/index.md gains a timeline line for the note; adds a session-log entry with `pka-tools log add --role pka-meetings`; runs no git command

Robin: Fine by me. I'll bring the hiring plan next week.
